title: A Atlas for the Orchard
author: Jonah Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Nakamura, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
